name: genesis-world
description_en: Simulation platform for general-purpose robotics & embodied AI learning.
readme_excerpt: Genesis World Genesis World is a simulation platform for physical AI developments. It combines a unified multi-physics engine, a photo-realistic renderer (Nyx), and a cross-platform compiler (Quadrants) behind a Pythonic simulation interface. Genesis World is designed to scale from a single laptop kernel to datacenter-grade GPUs, while remaining easy to read, extend, and embed in research code.
